name: pivot_last_row_of_a_pair_wins
query: SELECT year, root(account, 2) AS category, month, count(*) AS n WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:(Food|Home)' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY month DESC, year, category PIVOT BY year, category
notes: When several rows share a (first, second) pair, the last one in result order fills the cells: here the earliest month of each year.
